label: background gh pr state watcher with break on merge (real session)
command: cd "$REPO"; for i in $(seq 1 40); do s=$(for n in 227 228 229; do gh pr view $n --repo owner/repo --json state -q .state; done | tr '\n' ' '); echo "$s"; case "$s" in *OPEN*) sleep 15;; *) break;; esac; done; for n in 227 228 229; do gh pr view $n --repo owner/repo --json state,mergedAt -q "\"#$n \(.state) mergedAt=\(.mergedAt)\""; done

label: background retarget-and-queue watcher with break (real session)
command: cd "$REPO"; done229=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do s228=$(gh pr view 228 --repo owner/repo --json state -q .state); s229=$(gh pr view 229 --repo owner/repo --json state,baseRefName -q '"\(.state) \(.baseRefName)"'); echo "t=$((i*15))s 228=$s228 229=$s229"; if [ "$s228" = "MERGED" ] && [ $done229 = 0 ]; then gh pr edit 229 --repo owner/repo --base main >/dev/null 2>&1; gh pr edit 229 --repo owner/repo --add-label admin-bypass >/dev/null 2>&1; done229=1; fi; case "$s229" in MERGED*) break;; esac; sleep 15; done

label: corrected form: background until-loop that exits when the PR merges
command: until gh pr view 228 --json state -q .state | grep -q MERGED; do sleep 30; done; gh pr view 228 --json mergedAt -q .mergedAt

label: corrected form: background sleep then one report (a wakeup, not a poll)
short settle sleep before a single read, foreground (real session)
merge then 3s settle then one view, foreground (real session)
command: cd "$REPO"; gh pr merge 7 --merge --subject "[auto] gate: six coverage gates (#7)" 2>&1 | tail -2; sleep 3; gh pr view 7 --json state,mergedAt -q '"#7 \(.state) mergedAt=\(.mergedAt)"'

label: for over PR numbers with a settle sleep, not a retry loop, foreground (real session)
command: cd "$REPO"; for n in 8 9; do st=$(gh pr view $n --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus -q '"\(.mergeable)/\(.mergeStateStatus)"'); echo "#$n pre: $st"; if [ "$st" = "MERGEABLE/CLEAN" ]; then gh pr merge $n --merge 2>&1 | tail -1; sleep 3; gh pr view $n --json state,mergedAt; else echo "#$n NOT merged: $st"; fi; done

label: no sleep at all
command: git status --porcelain && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
